source_units.text: Provide a pronunciation key for an invented language.
Aim the wording at actors speaking the invented language Orin.
Keep the tone instructive and uncluttered.
Include the following invented details: The invented word sela means welcome and is pronounced SEH-lah.
Instruct actors to stress the first syllable and keep both vowels clear.
It is a fictional pronunciation convention, not a claim about a real language.
Preserve these exact phrases: "sela", "SEH-lah", "stress the first syllable".
